svg.text: After the approach of Bruce Macdonald, Vancouver: A Visual History, 1992. Original drawing from cited sources.

Locations are approximate and shown at a general scale only. Names are spelled as the Nations publish them. Only sites with a published source are shown; many more places existed (Musqueam alone records 120+ place names), so blank areas are not empty land.
Tidal flats and shallows since filled

Data: Shoreline and streams, 1880–1920: Lesack & Proctor, Vancouver's Old Streams (UBC Library, CC0 1.0), from Sharon J. Proctor, Vancouver's Old Streams (Vancouver Public Aquarium Association, 1978) · Terrain: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen
Terrarium), open elevation data · Today's coastline: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)

Sites and facts: Musqueam Indian Band; Squamish Nation and the Squamish Atlas (Kwi Awt Stelmexw); Tsleil-Waututh Nation; Museum of Anthropology at UBC; PLOS One; City of Vancouver Archives (Matthews). Full list in the credits.
The base is modern elevation, so hills are today's shape. Shown at about 1:60,000. Names and dots mark general areas only, not exact sites.
